charter.mission: Read the meeting notes under notes/ in the workspace and write summary.md: one line per note with its main point, then a section 'Contradictions' that lists any statements in different notes that cannot both be true.
constraints: Do not modify the files under notes/.

g1.text: Write summary.md with one line per note and a Contradictions section
criteria: summary.md has one line for each file under notes/
summary.md has a 'Contradictions' section naming every conflicting pair of statements
g1.result: 1) summary.md exists: fs_write reported writing it. 2) It has one line for each of monday.md, tuesday.md and wednesday.md. 3) Its Contradictions section names the Friday 14:00 vs Thursday 10:00 demo conflict, the only conflict found.
